cd.help.bg: How solid the bar's panel is. At 0% only the tiles show; at 100% the panel is fully opaque. Its colour follows your theme.
cd.help.display: Bar: one panel lists every active effect. Placed: each ticked effect gets its own small tile that shows only while it is active. Move the tiles in the layout editor, where all of them show. Up to 30 tiles.
cd.help.hidden: Also list and show internal effects that have no name or icon. Experimental: some of them change too fast to be useful.
cd.help.hideEmpty: Hide the bar while nothing is on cooldown. It shows again as soon as something is active, and always shows while you edit the layout. Open settings with F8 or the Stellar menu while it's hidden.
cd.help.mode: Only ticked: the bar shows just the ones you tick here. All except ticked: the bar shows everything except the ones you tick. Skills, debuffs and buffs each have their own choice.
cd.help.placedNote: In Placed mode every ticked effect is its own tile, so only ticked effects show. Skills, debuffs and buffs keep their own Only ticked / All except ticked choice for when you switch back to Bar.

cd.launcher.title: CooldownBar
cd.placed.note: Placed shows only the ticked effects, each as its own tile.
cd.sel.consequence.exceptBuffs: Nothing will be hidden. The bar will show every buff.
cd.sel.consequence.exceptDebuffs: Nothing will be hidden. The bar will show every debuff.
cd.sel.consequence.exceptSkills: Nothing will be hidden. The bar will show every skill cooldown.
cd.sel.consequence.onlyBuffs: The bar will show no buffs until you tick some again.
cd.sel.consequence.onlyDebuffs: The bar will show no debuffs until you tick some again.
cd.sel.consequence.onlySkills: The bar will show no skill cooldowns until you tick some again.
